name: Minamoto no Kurou Yoshitsune
source:
A general of the Genji army, his brother is Minamoto no Yoritomo.
One of the Hachiyou that protects the Priestess, the Seiryuu of Earth.
He believes a dangerous battlefield is no place for a women so he acts curt to the protagonist.
Because of his sharp tongue he is often misunderstood, but he's good at taking care of people.
The hard working type, for the sake of the Genji clan he fights with all his might.
